capabilities: Sync vault files across devices through a self-hosted server
Merge concurrent edits and keep both versions of conflicts
Restore file version history and recover deleted files
Approve new devices from an already-syncing device or the server
extras: README warns to always back up your vault before installing. Notes an upcoming 1.7 release that drops older device versions and requires SSL (wss) by default, with an 'Allow insecure connection' setting as fallback. Mentions screenshots (removed from this text) and points bug reports to the GitHub issue tracker.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sync a vault through a server you host yourself, so users must rely on paid services or hand-rolled setups.
summary: Self-hosted vault synchronization that encrypts traffic, merges concurrent edits, and keeps version history and deleted-file recovery on your own server.
